changelog: Smoother settings updates with bounded refresh scheduling and reliable Activity hand-offs.
RPC text previews stay local until Save; Cancel no longer changes your active presence settings.
Home layout edits accumulate correctly and apply the exact saved layout.
Fixed settings search restoration and legacy settings returning after a reset.
Subtitle burn-in now checks WiFi-only and charging rules at download/export start.
Unsupported time-lock, format-conversion and unsafe bulk-delete controls are clearly unavailable.
Some quiet traces still wait to be found.
message: v727 - smoother settings and safer editing
